title: Threshold - low-CPU six-lane patch plan
status: plan only: no Rack patch was built, loaded, auditioned or rendered
owner: Codex integrates and may revoice; this file states intent, not parameter values
principles: Two PVX voices carry all pitched material: one lead, one bass.
Percussion is one compact algorithmic/noise source; Codex may split or combine lanes 1-3.
One restrained Spoon Bender provides space; no large reverb network.
No firmware emulation, no large sample/voice banks, no optical waveform prerequisite, no percussive DC pulses.

lanes.name: kick
lanes.plan: Compact algorithmic kick from the percussion voice; short envelope, no layered sub stack.
lanes.note: Gesture A is the syncopated 0,3,6,8,11,14 figure; gesture B is the half-time 0,6,10 stomp.

lanes.name: snare
lanes.plan: Noise-based snare/clap from the same percussion voice; one hit at a time.
lanes.note: Backbeat in gesture A, half-time hit on row 8 in gesture B.

lanes.name: hat
lanes.plan: Short filtered noise hat; Codex may merge it into the percussion voice if the rig prefers.
lanes.note: 8th-note bed in acts 1 and 3, 16th-note drive in the works act.

lanes.name: riff/lead
lanes.plan: One PVX voice, monophonic, mid register; the dry relay-skip riff and the angular descent gesture share it.
lanes.note: Written range MIDI 57-81; no chords or overlapping gates.

lanes.name: bass
lanes.plan: One PVX voice, monophonic, low register; chunky short notes in gesture A and long weighted notes in gesture B.
lanes.note: Written range MIDI 38-53; no overlapping gates.

lanes.name: ambient/counterline
lanes.plan: Sparse high counterline through the restrained Spoon Bender return; 34 events in 120 seconds.
lanes.note: Written range MIDI 69-89; long rests are intentional.

PVX_lead.cpu_note: One instance, one voice, no unison or voice bank.

PVX_bass.cpu_note: One instance, one voice, low register.

percussion.role: kick, snare and hat from one small algorithmic/noise source
percussion.cpu_note: Codex chooses the module and may combine lanes; no sampled drum kit is required.

space.role: one restrained Spoon Bender send for the counterline
space.cpu_note: Restrained settings; the dry lead and bass stay forward.

routing_intent: Lanes 4 and 5 to separate PVX voices, both dry and forward.
Lanes 1-3 to the compact percussion source.
Lane 6 through a modest Spoon Bender return, not a global wash.
No sidechain network, no multi-tap delay, no external sequencer.
codex_discretion: All machine numbers in score.json are neutral slots; Codex may keep or replace them.
Percussion may be combined or revoiced without changing the note data.
No parameter values are asserted here because no patch was loaded.
